_about: NWIOI track catalog. Tier I · Core Program: a fixed package (99 CEUs + supervision for the credential + SAR). Tier II · À La Carte: individual courses, supervision and SAR. status 'approved' = shown to the public; 'draft' = preview only (signed-in admin or NWIOI_PREVIEW=1).

recommendation._note: If someone has already done at least this share of the credential's supervision target, they no longer need a full supervision package, so À La Carte is recommended.

planningRate._note: Planning rate for additional NWIOI coursework beyond the 99 Core CEUs. Additional courses depend on current availability.

library.note: Additional NWIOI courses depend on current availability.
library._note: Set url to the NWIOI course library page (for example https://www.nwioi.com/challenges once confirmed).

coreKnowledgeExample: For example, a human sexuality course or a training on sexual development.

trainingDay._note: Used only to describe prior hours as "about N full days of training". Confirm the length of an NWIOI training day.

paymentOptions._note: Applies to Core Program tuition only. Total = tuition x (1 - discount), rounded to the cent. Monthly = total / months rounded to the cent; the final payment is adjusted so the payments add up to the exact total. No installment fees.

equityScholarship.title: Equity Scholarship
equityScholarship.copy: NWIOI offers up to two Equity Scholarship seats each year across our Core Programs. Approved recipients receive 5% off tuition and can spread payments over 24 months with no added fees. Ask us about eligibility and availability.
equityScholarship._verifiedSeatsNote: Only set from a verified admissions record, e.g. {"remaining": 1, "year": 2027, "asOf": "2027-01-15", "source": "Admissions roster"}. The calculator never reserves or decrements seats.
equityScholarship._note: Stands on its own: one tuition discount per enrollment (not combined with pay-in-full or installment discounts). Availability and eligibility confirmed by NWIOI.
equityScholarship._applicationNote: Existing NWIOI scholarship application form, shown as a secondary link. The main CTA goes to the admissions inquiry link (Admin → Links).
